publicationPolicy: Immutable releases. Source linkage is not agronomic validation. A trusted maintainer reviews a diff and evidence before a normal source-controlled release; no runtime import or client self-publication. Retain prior releases for rollback.

coverage.missing: Comprehensive crop/region prevalence, crop-specific treatment, registered labels, India contamination standards, calibrated diagnostic performance and licensed trained image models are not bundled. Unknown crops receive general triage.
